title: Buy this! Amazing smell and moisture allllll day!
date: Bewertet in den USA am13. Dezember 2025
review: It smells SOOOO GOOD!!! I get compliments all the time about how good I smell, and my boyfriend is extra snuggly when I wear this. I’m in my late 30s and have started suffering from really dry skin all of a sudden. When I get out of the shower and dry off, I immediately rub this oil all over. Then I put my robe back on and continue getting ready while the oil absorbs. If you can shower at night and put it on, I would recommend that so it’s got all night to absorb. It’s a medium thickness, so for me, it does take a little while to absorb. If I take morning showers and need to immediately go somewhere, I put on less oil. Ideally, I shower at night, then put on the oil to let it absorb overnight, and then apply the EOS vanilla lotion in the morning. Both the oil and lotion smell divine, and they pair really well with Burberry Goddess perfume. I love the EOS vanilla shave oil and lip balm, too! Alternatively, you can do the Tree Hut vanilla shave oil and sugar scrub. Right now I’m also loving the limited time Olay Sugar Cookie body wash to go with everything. I may have a vanilla obsession problem right now, lol! Anyway, you will not be disappointed with this product, so do yourself a favor and get it!
